newsitem.title: UK: RANK INDICATED LOWER AS RESULTS DISAPPOINT.
newsitem.headline: RANK INDICATED LOWER AS RESULTS DISAPPOINT.

text.p: Shares in British leisure company Rank Plc were indicated lower in pre-market trade on Thursday after first half profits fell short of market expectations.
The shares were indicated 9p lower at 361-1/2p by 0720 GMT.
Rank reported a 12 million stg drop in first half profits to 87 million stg before tax and exceptional items.
Analysts were expecting profits of around 93 million stg.
The company also said it would increase its share buy-back programme, adding that it expects an improvmenet in performance in the second half of the year.
"We were disappointed even though they were talking about a maximum share buy-back, it wasn't enough to counteract the numbers which came in way below expectations," said one senior dealer.
Rank said exchange rate movements cut current pretax profit by two million stg and would continue to impact on the full year at current rates.
